name: marketing-ai-copilot-dashboard
purpose: Deterministic consolidated dataset for public portfolio dashboard. Missing facts must be marked manual_required, ignored, not_configured, or api_error.
rules: Project identity belongs to project configs and cron jobs, not universal skill prompts.
The consolidated dashboard may compare projects, but CPA is project-specific and goal-specific.
Direct Conversions are diagnostic only and are never treated as lead truth.
Metrika goals inventory is collected through yandex_metrika_goals when a project counter is known.
If TurboPageIds or Metrika goal ids are missing, lead count is not reported as zero.
Plan 2 connector gaps are tracked in marketing/connectors_manifest.json and must not be inferred from current API data.
Public pages should consume view_model and status-wrapped variables instead of raw API blocks.
Any unavailable variable remains manual_required or ignored so analysis cannot hallucinate it.
